description: RODeO, published by NatLabRockies, optimises site equipment design and operation as a price-taking mixed-integer model, including generators, storage and flexible loads. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is BSD-3-Clause. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: Running the model requires GAMS and an appropriate solver; the original development used CPLEX. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support optimisation, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
